snippet.title: Multi Modal Transit - out now on iOS and Mac OS
snippet.description:
Multi Modal Transit is a puzzle game about keeping a growing city moving. Start with roads, then add buses, trams and the underground as homes and workplaces spread. Can you keep the network moving before it breaks?

Eight cities, each with its own way to move: London, Las Vegas, Venice, Rio, Stockholm, Mexico City, San Francisco and Amsterdam.

Out now on Mac, iPhone and iPad, with a free demo you can play in your browser.

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/multi-modal-transit/id6797282707

Itch: https://southlondonsilicon.itch.io/multi-modal
